description: The linear ring of latex/notes/fct_experiment_plan.tex (sec:presets, the dictionary tab:dictionary) at sigma^2 = 0: N = 64 hidden units on a ring, hidden kernel length_scale 4 sites (box = N = 64), P = 256 patterns; linear_teacher with m = n = 8 features, K = 3 latents uniform on [0, 1] and an orthonormal teacher; L = 1, phi id, g 1; k0 = k1 = 1 (input and output kernels of length_scale 0 and amplitude 1, weight_lambda 1, so k = 1 / weight_lambda); r = rate_lambda = 0; beta 0.25 (prediction 1, regime a1); SGLD, float64; every population on the deterministic grid. B = 64 members and one sample per member, its final state after 2 x 10^5 epochs: statistics are of the member-averaged final-state spectrum, with errors from the spread across members (at B = 64 a q = 0 share has standard error 0.025 and R(1)/R(0) 0.0015); the spectrum records (every 500 epochs) are only a burn-in diagnostic, with the first 10^4 epochs as burn-in. Predicted by fct.linear_theory.predicted_spectra on the seed-0 data (whitened): q_1/2 = 2, q = 0 shares 0.157, R(1)/R(0) 0.969 for every mode, d_0 ratio of mode 1 to mode 2 9.36 (the measured s_k^2; 10.08 from the formula values). The axes cross spatial.parametrisation [penalty, whitened] with train.lr [1.2e-4, 0.005], and the diagonal is the experiment: setting 0 (penalty, lr 1.2e-4) and setting 3 (whitened, lr 0.005), run with `exp run ROOT --index 0` and `--index 3` (`bash jobs/fct_exp.sh ROOT --submit --index 0`, `--index 3`). Setting 1 (penalty at 0.005) is refused at run start by the penalty's step check; setting 2 (whitened at 1.2e-4) runs and shows the whitened result does not depend on lr. Each lr comes from its own run-start check. Penalty: lr k_max = 0.48, k_max = weight_lambda / (beta min_rel_eig lambda_0) = 3988 the curvature of the floored modes (the check refuses lr k_max >= 2), which inflates their variance by 1.3x and moves R(1)/R(0) by 3e-4. Whitened: lr lambda_max(loss Hessian) = 0.025 (lambda_max = 4.9 at the prior initial state, the logged check value; refused at >= 1), a 1% inflation of every prior mode. min_rel_eig 1e-4 floors |q| >= 11 (a 9e-4 change in R(1)/R(0); 1e-3 would move it by 9e-3, six standard errors) and lets the penalty's softest data-carrying mode relax in about 2 x 10^4 epochs; under the default 1e-6 the check would refuse any lr above 5e-6. Both parametrisations start from the prior (init prior, which whitened requires). Every other beta or weight_lambda needs its own lr pair: set beta with --set beta= and the pair with --axis 'train.lr=[...]' by the same two rules, and check that the run-start log of the whitened setting reports lr lambda_max <= 0.1.
